career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest career risk is not AI alone but programmatic plus self-service tools. Platforms absorb standard inventory, while people with account-development ability become more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this occupation is not AI but programmatic plus self-service tools. Self-service advertising and programmatic buying absorb standard inventory and pressure commission models, while major accounts still require human relationship management.
risks: Programmatic tools replace standard roles
Self-service advertising replacement
Commission model under pressure
High performance volatility
Customer relationships are easy to lose

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable platforms become, salespeople still decide which clients are worth developing, how to frame a partnership, and how to negotiate the budget. Human judgment plans the account, human communication earns trust, and a person signs the contract. People cannot be removed from revenue entirely.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「程序化 + 自助化」——标准资源被平台吃，有经营力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「程序化 + 自助化」——自助投放平台与程序化购买吃掉标准广告位，且佣金模式受压；同时大客户仍要人经营。
risks: 程序化吃标准岗
自助投放替代
佣金模式受压
业绩波动大
客户关系易流失

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管平台多聪明，哪类客户值得养、怎么讲成合作、预算怎么谈，最后还是销售的脑去想、嘴去说、手去签——营收这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI alone but the combination of generative disruption and a narrow skill set. Routine production artists are easiest to replace; moving into creative strategy offers greater stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are generative disruption and client price pressure. Tools such as Midjourney have commoditized routine image production and assets, reducing junior production art roles, while clients maintain high visual standards and request frequent revisions. People who advance toward creative strategy and coordination are more secure; execution-only production artists are easier to replace.
risks: Generative tools absorb routine image production
Frequent client revisions
Industry-cycle fluctuations
Junior production art roles contract
Aesthetic standards change quickly

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how proficient tools become at producing visuals, the art director still has to judge whether an option fits the brand and delivers the feeling the client wants, then defend and finalize that decision. People remain essential to visual decision-making.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「生成式冲击 + 技能单一」——只做常规美编最易被替，向创意策略转才稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「生成式冲击 + 甲方压价」——Midjourney 等把常规出图与素材拉平，初级美编缩；同时客户对视觉要求高、改稿多。向「创意策略 + 统筹」走的人更稳，纯执行美编易被替。
risks: 生成式吃常规出图
甲方改稿多
行业周期波动
初级美编缩
审美更新快

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多会出图，那版和品牌对不对味、客户要的「感觉」对不对，最后还是艺术总监的眼去看、嘴去争、手去定——视觉决策这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but career planning. Build strong technical and management abilities during service to preserve broad civilian transition options.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but the nature of the career itself. Military positions have mandatory rules for service duration, promotion assessment, and transfers. Technical officers also face continuous learning pressure from rapidly evolving equipment, while the fit between civilian transition options and their specialty shapes long-term planning.
risks: Military positions impose service-duration and promotion constraints
Intensive training and garrison life offer limited personal freedom
Rapid equipment advances create continuous learning pressure
The fit between transition destinations and professional skills affects long-term planning
Readiness duty makes work-family balance difficult

page.contract_project_risk_block: Military careers are governed by military regulations, with clear systems for service duration, rank promotion, and transition placement. Before applying to a military academy, understand service obligations and assignment rules. The latest national regulations govern post-service placement.

responsibilities: Organize fire units to complete firing missions
Perform readiness duty and exercise responsibilities

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「职业规划」——服役期内把技术与管理能力沉淀好，转业去向才会宽。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI 而是「职业属性本身」——军队岗位有服役年限、晋升考评与调动的硬性规则，技术军官还需应对装备快速迭代的学习压力；退役转业去向与专业匹配度决定长期规划空间。
risks: 军队岗位有服役年限与晋升约束
训练强度与驻训生活个人自由度低
装备快速迭代带来持续学习压力
转业去向与专业匹配度影响长期规划
战备值班与家庭生活平衡难

page.contract_project_risk_block: 军人职业按军队法规管理，服役年限、衔级晋升与转业安置均有明确制度；报考军校前务必了解服务期与分配规则，退役安置政策以国家最新规定为准。

responsibilities: 组织火力分队完成射击任务
履行战备值班与演练职责

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but mechanization. Systems absorb simple plant-care work, while people who can care for plants and recognize disease are more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but mechanization. Automation is absorbing irrigation, climate control, and some harvesting, but transplanting, pollination, and precision plant care still require people. Outdoor intensity and seasonal volatility also remain substantial.
risks: Climate-control automation
Irrigation replacement
Mechanized harvesting
Outdoor physical demands
Seasonal volatility

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, farmworkers still use their hands to transplant seedlings, their eyes to identify diseased leaves, and their judgment to harvest fruit. People cannot be fully removed from the field.

responsibilities: Stack containers and send produce for inspection

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「机械化」——简单管护被系统吃，会管护、能辨病的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不在 AI，而在「机械化」——灌溉、环控与部分采收被自动化接管，但移栽、授粉与精细管护仍要人；同时户外强度与季节性波动大。
risks: 环控自动化
灌溉替代
采收机械化
户外强度
季节波动

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，苗怎么移栽、病叶怎么辨、果怎么采，最后还是农工的手去种、眼去看、脑去判——田间这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The largest career risk comes from technology + staffing. Counting patrols are shrinking, while people with enforcement and rescue capabilities have greater stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The largest career risk is not AI but budget and staffing volatility. Drones and remote sensing replace parts of patrol work, but people still handle field enforcement, rescue, and conflict response.
risks: Staffing and budget volatility
Technology replaces patrol work
High field danger
Conflicts can escalate
Remote locations are hard to staff

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable equipment becomes, wardens still decide how to enforce laws, rescue wildlife, and resolve conflicts on site. Protecting ecosystems continues to require human judgment, fieldwork, and action.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「技术 + 编制」——计数巡护被吃，有执法与救助力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是预算与编制波动——巡护被无人机、遥感部分替代，但现场执法、救助与冲突处置仍要人。
risks: 编制预算波动
技术替巡护
野外危险高
冲突易升级
偏远难留住

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管设备多聪明，现场怎么执法、动物怎么救、冲突怎么化，最后还是管理员的人去想、腿去走、手去办——守生态这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: A must to enter the industry and grow quickly

career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest occupational risk is not AI, but the "industry boom" - the more and more advanced the machines, the more valuable the people who can repair them are, but only if the factory is still open.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk is not AI, but the "prosperity of the manufacturing industry": demand for equipment maintenance follows the factory's operating rate, and jobs will shrink when the economy downturns and production lines are relocated, and conversely, rush repairs and preventive maintenance will be overwhelmed.
risks: Fluctuations in manufacturing prosperity directly determine the number of jobs
Emergency repairs and shift work, irregular work and rest hours
Oil pollution, noise environment and occupational injury risks
Pure replacement jobs are squeezed by digitization and outsourcing
Skills are updated quickly. If you don’t learn new equipment, you will be eliminated.

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can predict failures, dispatch work orders, and analyze vibrations, but "does the bearing feel and clearance correct when it is installed? Do you dare to return this machine to the production line?" This judgment is always in the hands of the machinist.

responsibilities: Disassembly and replacement of mechanical parts
Manage spare parts and repair files
skills: Maintenance records and spare parts management

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「行业景气」——机器越多、越先进，会修的人越值钱，但前提是工厂还在开。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「制造业的景气度」：设备维修需求跟着工厂开工率走，经济下行、产线外迁时岗位会缩，反之抢修和预防性维护都忙不过来。
risks: 制造业景气度波动直接决定岗位数量
抢修与倒班，作息不规律
油污噪音环境与职业损伤风险
纯换件型岗位被数字化与外包挤压
技能更新快，不学新设备就被淘汰

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能预测故障、派工单、分析振动，但「这颗轴承装回去手感和间隙对不对、这台机器敢不敢交回产线」——这个判断，永远在机械师手里。

skills: 电气基础与 PLC 认知

career_path_block.说明: Heavy responsibility and frequent night shifts
Lead a team, with pressure shifting to management
Replaced by electronic medical records and AI

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but responsibility and workload. Caring for your physical and mental health is essential to safeguarding the delivery room over the long term.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but responsibility and workload. Maternal and infant safety is non-negotiable, the legal consequences of an error during delivery are extremely serious, and chronic understaffing and frequent night shifts contribute to persistently high burnout and turnover.
risks: Frequent night shifts that disrupt sleep cycles and drain physical stamina
Maternal and infant safety is non-negotiable, creating intense responsibility
Falling birth rates reduce some obstetric caseloads
The legal risks of medical disputes cannot be ignored
AI replaces documentation-only roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: Healthcare employment contracts should clearly specify established or contract status, night-shift allowances, responsibility for professional risks, and continuing education arrangements. Review every clause on midwifery qualification registration and periodic assessment.

responsibilities: Provide prenatal care and checkup services
Identify high-risk cases and assist with emergency treatment and referral

career_path_block.说明: 被电子病历与 AI 替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「责任与强度」——把身心照顾好，才能长期守住产房。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI 而是「责任与强度」——母婴安全一票否决，接产差错的法律后果极其严重；产房人手不足、夜班密集，职业倦怠与流失率长期偏高。
risks: 夜班密集，生物钟与体力透支
母婴安全一票否决，责任压力大
生育率下行，部分产科业务收缩
医疗纠纷法律风险不容忽视
纯文书岗位被 AI 替代

page.contract_project_risk_block: 医疗行业合同要看清编制/合同制、夜班补贴、执业风险责任与继续教育安排；助产资格注册与定期考核条款要逐条确认。

responsibilities: 提供孕期保健与产检服务
独立完成正常分娩接产
实施产后与新生儿照护
识别高危并配合抢救转诊
skills: 产后护理与母乳喂养指导

career_path_block.说明: Stable plant rhythm with rotating duty
Heavy review responsibility and high value

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but responsibility. Nuclear safety permits zero errors, and every engineering decision carries potentially irreversible consequences that not everyone can bear.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risks are safety responsibility and industry cycles. Nuclear safety permits zero errors, and incidents have serious consequences. Nuclear projects also have long cycles and strict approvals, so employment conditions are strongly affected by policy cycles.
risks: Zero-tolerance pressure: major safety responsibility and extremely high cost of errors
Industry-cycle impact: project approvals determine hiring conditions
Low career mobility: the nuclear sector is small, limiting job-switching options
Remote workplaces: many nuclear plants are in remote coastal areas
AI replacement of junior calculation roles: functions limited to running cases are shrinking

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well AI calculates, nuclear safety decisions must remain in human hands. Calculation can be accelerated, but responsibility can never be outsourced.

responsibilities: Monitor operations and respond to anomalies
Manage the fuel cycle and radiation protection

career_path_block.说明: 电厂节奏，稳定但要轮值
被 AI 仿真加速挤压

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「责任」——核安全零容错，工程师的每个决定都背着不可逆的代价，这种压力不是谁都扛得住。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「安全责任与行业周期」——核安全是零容错的，出了事就是大事；同时核电项目周期长、审批严，岗位稳定性受政策周期影响明显。
risks: 零容错压力：安全责任重大，犯错代价极高
行业周期影响：项目审批节奏决定岗位景气度
职业变动性低：核电圈子小，跳槽半径有限
工作地点偏：核电厂多位于沿海偏远地区
初级计算岗被 AI 替代：纯跑算例的职能在收缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: 无论 AI 多会算，核安全里「敢不敢拍板」这件事都得留在人手上——计算可以加速，责任永远不能外包。

responsibilities: 开展堆物理与热工计算
管理燃料循环与辐射防护
skills: 反应堆物理与热工水力

career_path_block.说明: Advances through performance and repeat customers

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but remaining in a basic role. Advancement into store management, operations, and data-driven work still offers a stable upward path.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI, but replacement and turnover. Self-checkout, online shopping, and smart replenishment reduce frontline jobs, while pay is modest and advancement takes time. Many workers treat it as transitional employment.
risks: Self-checkout and online diversion reduce frontline jobs
Modest income and long promotion cycles
Standing and shifts create significant physical demands
Holiday work limits personal time
Performance pressure and high turnover

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can process payments, replenish stock, and deliver promotions, but only a living person can make customers feel seen, advised, and remembered when they enter. Retail transactions can be self-service; retail warmth cannot.

responsibilities: Execute promotions and maintain the store

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在基础岗」——向店长、运营和数据化方向走，这行依然有稳定的上升空间。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「替代与流动」：自助收银、线上购物和智能补货在挤压一线岗位，同时该岗位收入不高、晋升周期长，多数从业者把它当作过渡性工作。
risks: 自助收银与线上分流挤压一线岗位
收入不高，晋升周期长
站立倒班，体力消耗明显
节假日无休，个人时间少
业绩考核压力与流动性大

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能收银、能补货、能推优惠，但顾客进门那一刻需要的「被看见、被推荐、被记住」，只有活人能给。零售的交易可以自助，零售的温度不能。
